def sql_sidecars(root: int, name: str) -> None:
    for suffix, cap in (
        ("-wal", 16 * 1024 * 1024),
        ("-shm", 1024 * 1024),
        ("-journal", 16 * 1024 * 1024),
    ):
        try:
            info = os.stat(name + suffix, dir_fd=root, follow_symlinks=False)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            continue
        assert stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode)
        assert info.st_uid == os.getuid()
        assert info.st_nlink == 1
        assert 0 <= info.st_size <= cap


def environment_projection(
    value: object, environment: str, endpoints: object, *, retained: object = None
) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Only bounded known scalars, bound to this fresh lab's original retained endpoint."""
    pattern = r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}"
    assert type(environment) is str
    assert re.fullmatch(pattern, environment)
    assert type(value) is dict
    fields = ("project_id", "environment_id", "sandbox", "sandbox_id", "state")
    assert all(name in value for name in fields)
    assert all(type(value[name]) is str for name in fields)
    assert all(re.fullmatch(pattern, value[name]) for name in fields[:-1])
    assert value["project_id"] == PROJECT
    assert value["environment_id"] == environment
    assert value["state"] in {"creating", "ready", "stopped", "deleted"}
    assert type(endpoints) is list
    if not endpoints:
        assert value["state"] == "stopped"
        assert type(retained) is dict
        assert set(retained) == set(fields)
        assert retained["state"] == "ready"
        assert all(type(retained[name]) is str for name in fields)
        assert all(re.fullmatch(pattern, retained[name]) for name in fields[:-1])
        assert all(value[name] == retained[name] for name in fields[:-1])
        return {name: value[name] for name in fields}
    assert len(endpoints) == 1
    row = endpoints[0]
    assert type(row) in (tuple, list)
    assert len(row) == 4
    assert all(type(item) is str and re.fullmatch(pattern, item) for item in row)
    assert (row[0], row[2], row[3]) == (environment, value["sandbox"], value["sandbox_id"])
    return {name: value[name] for name in fields}


def retained_stopped_binding(
    marker: dict[str, Any], current: object, phase: str, gateway: object = None
) -> dict[str, str]:
    """Prove only the original retired binding; never manufacture a current endpoint."""
    assert phase in ("before", "after")
    accepted = evidence(marker, "read")
    assert type(accepted) is dict
    assert accepted["sql_unchanged"] is True
    before, after = accepted["before"], accepted["after"]
    assert type(before) is dict and type(after) is dict
    assert before == after
    originals = before["environments"]
    assert type(originals) is list and len(originals) == 1
    original = originals[0]
    assert type(original) is dict
    assert set(original) == {"project_id", "environment_id", "sandbox", "sandbox_id", "state"}
    assert original["state"] == "ready"
    endpoints = before["executor_endpoints"]
    retained = environment_projection(original, marker["environment"], endpoints)
    actual = environment_projection(current, marker["environment"], endpoints)
    assert actual["state"] == "stopped"
    assert all(actual[key] == retained[key] for key in retained if key != "state")
    sql = {"environments": [actual]}
    if gateway is None:
        gateway_proof(marker, phase, sql)
    else:
        validate_stopped_gateway(marker, sql, gateway)
    return retained


def sql_snapshot(
    marker: dict[str, Any], *, stopped_phase: str | None = None, stopped_gateway: object = None
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Bounded mode=ro facts; retired endpoints require explicit fresh original-VM proof."""
    assert stopped_phase is None or stopped_phase in ("before", "after")
    assert stopped_gateway is None or stopped_phase is not None
    environments = (marker["environment"], marker["environment"])
    assert len(environments) == 2
    assert len(set(environments)) == 1
    root = directory("worker/state")
    result: dict[str, Any] = {}
    total = 0
    try:
        for name in ("worker.sqlite3", "environments.sqlite3"):
            fd = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK, dir_fd=root)
            try:
                info = os.fstat(fd)
                assert stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode)
                assert info.st_uid == os.getuid()
                assert info.st_nlink == 1
                assert 0 < info.st_size <= 128 * 1024 * 1024
                assert os.pread(fd, 16, 0) == b"SQLite format 3\0"
                sql_sidecars(root, name)
                db = sqlite3.connect(
                    f"file:{LAB / 'worker/state' / name}?mode=ro", uri=True, timeout=0.1
                )
                try:
                    db.execute("PRAGMA query_only=ON")
                    ticks = 0

                    def budget() -> int:
                        nonlocal ticks
                        ticks += 1
                        return int(ticks > 20000)

                    db.set_progress_handler(budget, 1000)
                    db.execute("BEGIN")
                    if name == "environments.sqlite3":
                        rows = db.execute(
                            "SELECT environment_id,typeof(document),length(CAST(document AS BLOB)),substr(CAST(document AS BLOB),1,65537) FROM environments WHERE environment_id IN (?,?) ORDER BY environment_id",
                            environments,
                        ).fetchall()
                        assert len(rows) == 1
                        values = []
                        for env, kind, size, raw in rows:
                            assert kind == "text"
                            assert type(size) is int
                            assert 0 < size <= 65536
                            value = decode(raw, 65536)
                            assert env == marker["environment"]
                            retained = None
                            if result["executor_endpoints"] == [] and stopped_phase is not None:
                                retained = retained_stopped_binding(
                                    marker, value, stopped_phase, stopped_gateway
                                )
                            values.append(
                                environment_projection(
                                    value, env, result["executor_endpoints"], retained=retained
                                )
                            )
                        result["environments"] = values
                    else:
                        tables = (
                            ("provisions", "provision_id", "record"),
                            ("revision_entries", "revision", "record"),
                            ("kernel_start_revisions", "session_id,language", "record"),
                        )
                        for table, order, column in tables:
                            count = db.execute(
                                f"SELECT count(*) FROM {table} WHERE environment_id IN (?,?)",
                                environments,
                            ).fetchone()[0]
                            assert type(count) is int
                            assert count <= 32
                            rows = db.execute(
                                f"SELECT environment_id,typeof({column}),length(CAST({column} AS BLOB)),substr(CAST({column} AS BLOB),1,65537) FROM {table} WHERE environment_id IN (?,?) ORDER BY environment_id,{order}",
                                environments,
                            ).fetchall()
                            values = []
                            for env, kind, size, raw in rows:
                                assert kind == "text"
                                assert type(size) is int
                                assert 0 < size <= 65536
                                assert type(raw) is bytes
                                assert len(raw) <= 65536
                                total += len(raw)
                                assert total <= 2 * 1024 * 1024
                                values.append(
                                    {
                                        "environment_id": env,
                                        "size": len(raw),
                                        "record_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                                    }
                                )
                            result[table] = values
                        for table, columns, order in (
                            (
                                "executor_endpoints",
                                "environment_id,substr(incarnation,1,129),substr(sandbox,1,129),substr(sandbox_id,1,129)",
                                "environment_id",
                            ),
                            (
                                "kernels",
                                "environment_id,substr(session_id,1,129),substr(language,1,16),substr(incarnation,1,129),CASE WHEN typeof(base)='integer' THEN base ELSE NULL END,CASE WHEN typeof(last)='integer' THEN last ELSE NULL END",
                                "environment_id,session_id,language",
                            ),
                            (
                                "package_execution_gates",
                                "environment_id,CASE WHEN typeof(generation)='integer' THEN generation ELSE NULL END,substr(mode,1,32),substr(operation,1,129),CASE WHEN typeof(revision) IN ('integer','null') THEN revision ELSE 'invalid' END",
                                "environment_id",
                            ),
                            (
                                "environment_revisions",
                                "environment_id,CASE WHEN typeof(revision)='integer' THEN revision ELSE NULL END,substr(fingerprint,1,129),substr(changed_by,1,129)",
                                "environment_id",
                            ),
                            (
                                "executions",
                                "environment_id,substr(execution_id,1,129),substr(session_id,1,129),CASE WHEN typeof(terminal)='integer' THEN terminal ELSE NULL END",
                                "environment_id,execution_id",
                            ),
                        ):
                            rows = db.execute(
                                f"SELECT {columns} FROM {table} WHERE environment_id IN (?,?) ORDER BY {order} LIMIT 33",
                                environments,
                            ).fetchall()
                            assert len(rows) <= 32
                            assert all(
                                type(x) in (str, int, type(None)) for row in rows for x in row
                            )
                            assert all(
                                not isinstance(x, str) or len(x) <= 128 for row in rows for x in row
                            )
                            integer_positions = {
                                "kernels": (4, 5),
                                "package_execution_gates": (1,),
                                "environment_revisions": (1,),
                                "executions": (3,),
                            }
                            assert all(
                                type(row[pos]) is int and 0 <= row[pos] <= 2**62
                                for row in rows
                                for pos in integer_positions.get(table, ())
                            )
                            if table == "package_execution_gates":
                                assert all(
                                    row[4] is None or (type(row[4]) is int and 0 <= row[4] <= 2**62)
                                    for row in rows
                                )
                            result[table] = rows
                    db.rollback()
                finally:
                    db.close()
                sql_sidecars(root, name)
                assert identity(os.fstat(fd)) == identity(
                    os.stat(name, dir_fd=root, follow_symlinks=False)
                )
                fresh = directory("worker/state")
                try:
                    assert identity(os.fstat(fresh)) == identity(os.fstat(root))
                finally:
                    os.close(fresh)
            finally:
                os.close(fd)
    finally:
        os.close(root)
    return decode(json.dumps(result, allow_nan=False).encode("utf-8"), 2 * 1024 * 1024)


def selected_sql_proof(
    marker: dict[str, Any], selected: list[dict[str, Any]]
) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
    """Two exact original rows/refs, bounded before decode; no full lockfile parse."""
    assert len(selected) == 2
    root = directory("worker/state")
    fd = -1
    try:
        name = "worker.sqlite3"
        fd = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK, dir_fd=root)
        info = os.fstat(fd)
        assert stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode)
        assert info.st_uid == os.getuid()
        assert info.st_nlink == 1
        assert 0 < info.st_size <= 128 * 1024 * 1024
        assert os.pread(fd, 16, 0) == b"SQLite format 3\0"
        sql_sidecars(root, name)
        result = []
        with contextlib.closing(
            sqlite3.connect(f"file:{LAB / 'worker/state' / name}?mode=ro", uri=True, timeout=0.1)
        ) as db:
            db.execute("PRAGMA query_only=ON")
            ticks = 0

            def budget() -> int:
                nonlocal ticks
                ticks += 1
                return int(ticks > 2000)

            db.set_progress_handler(budget, 1000)
            db.execute("BEGIN")
            try:
                for item in selected:
                    revision = item["revision"]
                    assert type(revision) is int
                    assert 0 <= revision <= 2**53 - 1
                    args = (marker["environment"], revision)
                    meta = db.execute(
                        "SELECT typeof(record),length(CAST(record AS BLOB)),typeof(lockfile),substr(CAST(lockfile AS BLOB),1,65),CASE WHEN typeof(lockfile_size)='integer' THEN lockfile_size END FROM revision_entries WHERE environment_id=? AND revision=?",
                        args,
                    ).fetchone()
                    assert meta is not None
                    kind, size, refkind, refsha, refsize = meta
                    assert kind == "text"
                    assert type(size) is int
                    assert 0 < size <= 65536
                    assert type(refsize) is int
                    assert 0 <= refsize <= 8 * 1024 * 1024
                    if refkind == "null":
                        assert refsha is None
                        assert refsize == 0
                    else:
                        assert refkind == "text"
                        assert type(refsha) is bytes
                        assert re.fullmatch(rb"[0-9a-f]{64}", refsha)
                    row = db.execute(
                        "SELECT substr(CAST(record AS BLOB),1,65537) FROM revision_entries WHERE environment_id=? AND revision=?",
                        args,
                    ).fetchone()
                    assert row is not None
                    assert type(row[0]) is bytes
                    assert len(row[0]) == size
                    raw = row[0]
                    decode(raw, 65536)  # Duplicate decoded keys refuse before typed normalization.
                    try:
                        record = EnvironmentRevision.model_validate_json(raw, strict=True)
                    except ValueError:
                        raise RuntimeError("selected revision metadata invalid") from None
                    ref = (
                        record.lockfile.model_dump(mode="json")
                        if record.lockfile is not None
                        else None
                    )
                    assert record.revision == revision
                    if ref is None:
                        assert refkind == "null"
                    else:
                        assert refkind == "text"
                        assert ref["sha256"].encode("ascii") == refsha
                        assert ref["size"] == refsize
                    proof = {
                        "revision": revision,
                        "record_sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
                        "lockfile": ref,
                    }
                    assert proof == item
                    result.append(proof)
            finally:
                db.rollback()
        sql_sidecars(root, name)
        assert identity(os.fstat(fd)) == identity(os.stat(name, dir_fd=root, follow_symlinks=False))
        fresh = directory("worker/state")
        try:
            assert identity(os.fstat(fresh)) == identity(os.fstat(root))
        finally:
            os.close(fresh)
        return result
    finally:
        if fd >= 0:
            os.close(fd)
        os.close(root)


def blob_proofs(selections: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> list[dict[str, Any] | None]:
    """Root-only local byte proof. No raw bytes, credentials or content export."""
    assert len(selections) == 2
    result: list[dict[str, Any] | None] = []
    held = []
    with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
        for selection in selections:
            ref = selection["lockfile"]
            if ref is None:
                result.append(None)
                continue
            sha, size = ref["sha256"], ref["size"]
            assert type(sha) is str
            assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{64}", sha)
            assert type(size) is int
            assert 0 < size <= 8 * 1024 * 1024
            root = directory("worker/state/lockfiles/blobs/" + sha[:2])
            stack.callback(os.close, root)
            fd = os.open(sha, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK, dir_fd=root)
            stack.callback(os.close, fd)
            before = os.fstat(fd)
            assert stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode)
            assert before.st_uid == os.getuid()
            assert before.st_nlink == 1
            assert before.st_size == size
            digest = hashlib.sha256()
            for offset in range(0, size, 8192):
                chunk = os.pread(fd, min(8192, size - offset), offset)
                assert len(chunk) == min(8192, size - offset)
                digest.update(chunk)
            assert digest.hexdigest() == sha
            held.append((root, fd, sha, before))
            result.append({"sha256": sha, "size": size, "actual_bytes_hashed": True})
        for root, fd, sha, before in held:
            fresh = directory("worker/state/lockfiles/blobs/" + sha[:2])
            try:
                assert identity(os.fstat(fresh)) == identity(os.fstat(root))
            finally:
                os.close(fresh)
            current = os.stat(sha, dir_fd=root, follow_symlinks=False)
            after = os.fstat(fd)
            fields = (
                "st_dev",
                "st_ino",
                "st_size",
                "st_mtime_ns",
                "st_ctime_ns",
                "st_uid",
                "st_nlink",
            )
            assert all(
                getattr(before, k) == getattr(current, k) == getattr(after, k) for k in fields
            )
    return result


class Checks:
    def __init__(
        self,
        head: str,
        marker: dict[str, Any],
        worker: aiohttp.ClientSession,
        gui: aiohttp.ClientSession,
        base: str,
    ) -> None:
        self.head, self.marker, self.worker, self.gui, self.base = head, marker, worker, gui, base

    def paths(
        self, suffix: str = "", query: dict[str, Any] | None = None, *, foreign: bool = False
    ) -> tuple[str, str]:
        env = self.marker["environment"]
        project = OTHER if foreign else PROJECT
        base = f"/environments/{env}/provisioning/observations"
        return "/v1" + base + suffix + "?" + urlencode(
            {"project_id": project, **(query or {})}
        ), f"/api/v0/projects/{project}" + base + suffix + ("?" + urlencode(query) if query else "")

    async def call(self, which: str, path: str, expected: int = 200) -> Any:
        guard(self.head)
        assert which in ("worker", "gui")
        assert path.startswith("/v1/" if which == "worker" else "/api/v0/")
        assert not any(c in path for c in ("#", "\\", "\x00"))
        http, base = (self.worker, WORKER) if which == "worker" else (self.gui, self.base)
        async with asyncio.timeout(12):
            async with http.get(
                base + path,
                allow_redirects=False,
                auto_decompress=False,
                timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=12),
            ) as response:
                assert response.status == expected, (which, path.split("?")[0], response.status)
                assert not response.headers.get("Content-Encoding")
                assert response.content_type == "application/json"
                if which == "gui":
                    assert response.headers.get("Cache-Control") == "no-store"
                raw = bytearray()
                chunks = 0
                async for chunk in response.content.iter_chunked(8192):
                    chunks += 1
                    assert chunks <= 256
                    assert len(raw) + len(chunk) <= 65536
                    raw.extend(chunk)
                value = decode(bytes(raw), 65536)
                return error_projection(value) if expected >= 400 else value

    async def pair(
        self, model: type[Model], suffix: str = "", query: dict[str, Any] | None = None
    ) -> Model:
        values = []
        for which, path in zip(("worker", "gui"), self.paths(suffix, query), strict=True):
            try:
                value = model.model_validate_json(
                    json.dumps(await self.call(which, path)), strict=True
                )
            except ValueError:
                raise RuntimeError("bounded observation metadata invalid") from None
            assert (value.project_id, value.environment_id) == (PROJECT, self.marker["environment"])
            values.append(value)
        same_observation(*values)
        return values[0]

    async def selected_revisions(self, before: int, after: int) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        assert type(before) is type(after) is int
        assert 0 <= before < after <= 2**53 - 1
        rows = []
        cursor = before - 1
        for _ in range(16):
            page = await self.pair(
                RevisionSummaryPage, "/revisions", {"after": cursor, "target": after, "limit": 8}
            )
            assert page.target == after
            rows.extend(r.model_dump(mode="json") for r in page.revisions)
            assert len(rows) <= 64
            if page.next_after is None:
                break
            assert page.next_after > cursor
            cursor = page.next_after
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("selected history exceeds helper bound")
        selected = [next(r for r in rows if r["revision"] == n) for n in (before, after)]
        selected = [{k: r[k] for k in ("revision", "record_sha256", "lockfile")} for r in selected]
        assert selected_sql_proof(self.marker, selected) == selected
        return selected

    async def packages(self, selected: dict[str, Any], *, all_pages: bool = True) -> dict[str, Any]:
        query = {"pin": selected["record_sha256"], "offset": 0, "limit": 8}
        pages: list[dict[str, Any]] = []
        keys: list[tuple[str, str, str]] = []
        first = None
        byte_count = 0
        for _ in range(64):
            page = await self.pair(
                RevisionPackagePage, f"/revisions/{selected['revision']}/packages", query
            )
            value = page.model_dump(mode="json")
            assert value["selection"] == selected
            assert page.offset == query["offset"]
            assert page.limit == 8
            assert page.status == "complete", "actual inventory source is held"
            assert page.total is not None
            assert 0 < page.total <= 512
            current = {
                "selection": value["selection"],
                "header": value["header"],
                "total": value["total"],
            }
            if first is None:
                first = current
            else:
                assert current == first
            for row in page.packages:
                key = (row.ecosystem, row.location or "", row.name)
                assert not keys or key > keys[-1]
                keys.append(key)
            assert len(keys) <= 512
            byte_count += len(page.model_dump_json().encode("utf-8"))
            assert byte_count <= 768 * 1024
            pages.append(value)
            if not all_pages or page.next_offset is None:
                break
            assert page.next_offset == query["offset"] + len(page.packages)
            assert page.next_offset > query["offset"]
            query["offset"] = page.next_offset
        else:
            raise RuntimeError("inventory exceeds helper page bound")
        assert first is not None
        if all_pages:
            assert len(keys) == first["total"]
        return {"pages": pages, "all_pages": all_pages, "recorded_total": first["total"]}

    async def read(self) -> None:
        operation = decode(bounded("evidence/revision-packages-operation.json", 4096), 4096)
        assert set(operation) == {"source_head", "run_id", "gp"}
        assert (operation["source_head"], operation["run_id"]) == (self.head, self.marker["run_id"])
        provision = operation["gp"]
        assert type(provision) is str
        assert re.fullmatch(r"prv-[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,120}", provision)
        before = sql_snapshot(self.marker)
        detail = await self.pair(ProvisionDetail, "/operations/" + provision)
        assert detail.request.capability == "gp"
        assert detail.request.operation_id == "lab32-gp-" + self.marker["run_id"]
        assert detail.request.context.session_id == "main"
        assert detail.summary.state == "finished"
        assert detail.summary.outcome == "completed"
        a, b = detail.summary.revision_before, detail.summary.revision_after
        assert a is not None
        assert b is not None
        assert type(a) is type(b) is int
        assert a >= 0
        assert b == a + 1
        selected = await self.selected_revisions(a, b)
        byte_proof = blob_proofs(selected)
        assert all(proof is not None for proof in byte_proof)
        inventories = [await self.packages(side) for side in selected]
        facts = inventory_facts(inventories)
        query = {"pin": selected[1]["record_sha256"], "offset": 0, "limit": 8}
        suffix = f"/revisions/{b}/packages"
        negative = []
        for name, changes, status, foreign in (
            (
                "wrong_pin",
                {"pin": ("0" if query["pin"][0] != "0" else "1") + query["pin"][1:]},
                409,
                False,
            ),
            ("foreign_project", {}, 404, True),
            ("invalid_limit", {"limit": 9}, 400, False),
        ):
            for which, path in zip(
                ("worker", "gui"),
                self.paths(suffix, {**query, **changes}, foreign=foreign),
                strict=True,
            ):
                error = await self.call(which, path, status)
                negative.append(
                    {
                        "case": name,
                        "route": which,
                        "status": status,
                        "error_kind": error["error_kind"],
                    }
                )
        for which, path in zip(("worker", "gui"), self.paths(suffix, query), strict=True):
            path = path.replace(
                "/environments/" + self.marker["environment"] + "/",
                "/environments/" + self.marker["foreign_environment"] + "/",
            )
            error = await self.call(which, path, 404)
            negative.append(
                {
                    "case": "foreign_environment",
                    "route": which,
                    "status": 404,
                    "error_kind": error["error_kind"],
                }
            )
        after = sql_snapshot(self.marker)
        assert before == after, "inventory reads changed allowlisted worker state"
        save(
            self.marker,
            "read",
            {
                "operation": detail.model_dump(mode="json"),
                "selected": selected,
                "inventories": inventories,
                "facts": facts,
                "selected_row_sql_verified": True,
                "actual_blob_proof": byte_proof,
                "negative": negative,
                "before": before,
                "after": after,
                "sql_unchanged": True,
                "synthetic_agpl_positive_runtime": False,
            },
        )

    async def idle_read(self) -> None:
        accepted = evidence(self.marker, "read")
        selected = accepted["selected"][1]
        expected = accepted["inventories"][1]["pages"][0]
        before = sql_snapshot(self.marker, stopped_phase="before")
        proof = gateway_proof(self.marker, "before", before)
        calls = []
        for _ in range(30):
            value = await self.packages(selected, all_pages=False)
            page = value["pages"][0]
            assert page == {**expected, "observed_at": page["observed_at"]}
            calls.append(
                {"observed_at": page["observed_at"], "status": 200, "total": page["total"]}
            )
            await asyncio.sleep(0.1)
        after = sql_snapshot(self.marker, stopped_phase="before")
        assert before == after
        save(
            self.marker,
            "idle-read",
            {
                "gateway_before": proof,
                "calls": calls,
                "before": before,
                "after": after,
                "sql_unchanged": True,
                "requires_fresh_post_read_gateway": True,
            },
        )


def inventory_facts(inventories: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """A real cross-revision unchanged entry and Conda addition, never an empty witness."""
    assert type(inventories) is list
    assert len(inventories) == 2
    rows, selections = [], []
    for inventory in inventories:
        assert inventory["all_pages"] is True
        pages = inventory["pages"]
        assert type(pages) is list
        assert 1 <= len(pages) <= 64
        selection = pages[0]["selection"]
        assert type(selection["revision"]) is int
        assert selection["revision"] >= 0
        selections.append(selection)
        row_map = {}
        for page in pages:
            assert page["status"] == "complete"
            assert page["selection"] == selection
            for row in page["packages"]:
                key = (row["ecosystem"], row["location"] or "", row["name"])
                assert key not in row_map
                row_map[key] = row
        assert 0 < len(row_map) == inventory["recorded_total"] <= 512
        rows.append(row_map)
    assert selections[1]["revision"] == selections[0]["revision"] + 1
    assert selections[0]["record_sha256"] != selections[1]["record_sha256"]
    old, new = rows
    unchanged = sorted(key for key in old.keys() & new.keys() if old[key] == new[key])
    added = sorted(new.keys() - old.keys())
    assert unchanged, "no actual unchanged package witness"
    assert any(key[0] == "conda" for key in added), "no actual Conda addition"
    return {
        "unchanged_witness": new[unchanged[0]],
        "unchanged_count": len(unchanged),
        "added": [list(key) for key in added],
        "before_total": len(old),
        "after_total": len(new),
        "declared_agpl_names_after": [
            row["name"] for row in new.values() if row["license"]["agpl"] is True
        ],
        "unknown_license_count_after": sum(
            row["license"]["declared"] is None for row in new.values()
        ),
        "installed_inventory_certification": False,
    }


def gateway_proof(marker: dict[str, Any], phase: str, sql: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    assert phase in ("before", "after")
    value = decode(bounded("evidence/revision-packages-gateway-" + phase + ".json", 16384), 16384)
    value = validate_stopped_gateway(marker, sql, value)
    stage = evidence_row(marker, "read" if phase == "before" else "idle-read")
    assert datetime.fromisoformat(value["observed_at"]) >= datetime.fromisoformat(
        stage["observed_at"]
    )
    return value


def validate_stopped_gateway(
    marker: dict[str, Any], sql: dict[str, Any], value: object
) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Fresh original-VM identity only; qualified runners prove their own read chronology."""
    assert type(value) is dict
    assert set(value) == {
        "version",
        "source_head",
        "run_id",
        "helper_sha256",
        "project_id",
        "observed_at",
        "sandboxes",
    }
    assert type(value["version"]) is int
    assert value["version"] == 1
    assert (value["source_head"], value["run_id"], value["helper_sha256"], value["project_id"]) == (
        marker["source_head"],
        marker["run_id"],
        marker["helper_sha256"],
        PROJECT,
    )
    assert type(value["observed_at"]) is str and 0 < len(value["observed_at"]) <= 64
    when = datetime.fromisoformat(value["observed_at"])
    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    assert when.tzinfo is not None
    assert when.utcoffset() == timedelta(0)
    assert now - timedelta(seconds=300) <= when <= now + timedelta(seconds=5)
    stage = evidence_row(marker, "read")
    assert when >= datetime.fromisoformat(stage["observed_at"])
    assert type(value["sandboxes"]) is list
    assert len(value["sandboxes"]) == 1
    row = value["sandboxes"][0]
    assert set(row) == {"environment_id", "name", "id", "phase"}
    assert all(type(x) is str and 0 < len(x) <= 128 for x in row.values())
    original = evidence(marker, "read")["before"]["environments"][0]
    current = sql["environments"][0]
    assert (row["environment_id"], row["name"], row["id"], row["phase"]) == (
        marker["environment"],
        original["sandbox"],
        original["sandbox_id"],
        "Stopped",
    )
    assert (current["environment_id"], current["sandbox"], current["sandbox_id"]) == (
        row["environment_id"],
        row["name"],
        row["id"],
    )
    return value


def final_stage(head: str, marker: dict[str, Any], stage: str) -> None:
    server = evidence(marker, "server")
    assert server["assets"] == assets()
    assert server["inputs"] == source_pins(head)
    if stage == "idle-confirm":
        prior = evidence(marker, "idle-read")
        current = sql_snapshot(
            marker, stopped_phase="after"
        )  # JSON-normalized tuples/lists at the producer boundary.
        assert prior["before"] == prior["after"] == current
        proof = gateway_proof(marker, "after", current)
        assert sql_snapshot(marker, stopped_phase="after") == current
        save(
            marker,
            "idle-confirm",
            {
                "gateway_after": proof,
                "sql_unchanged": True,
                "sql": current,
                "bounded_no_wake_paired_reads": 30,
                "continuous_lifecycle_proof": False,
            },
        )
    else:
        assert stage == "inspect"
        evidence(marker, "idle-confirm")
        save(
            marker,
            "inspect",
            {
                "source_pins": server["inputs"],
                "assets": server["assets"],
                "sql": sql_snapshot(marker, stopped_phase="after"),
                "actual_catalog_operations": 1,
                "inventory_stage": "passed",
                "idle_stage": "passed",
                "synthetic_missing_corruption_agpl_runtime": False,
            },
        )


async def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("stage", choices=STAGES)
    parser.add_argument("--head")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    if args.stage == "describe":
        print(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "admission_ready": ADMISSION_READY,
                    "project": PROJECT,
                    "stages": STAGES,
                    "effects": "none; root supplies one real baseline cell and GP operation",
                    "page_limit": 8,
                    "max_pages": 64,
                    "max_entries": 512,
                    "source": "exact reviewed source; root owns separate runtime admission and all effects",
                }
            )
        )
        return
    assert type(args.head) is str
    assert re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", args.head)
    if args.stage == "init":
        init(args.head)
        return
    marker = guard(args.head)
    if args.stage == "serve":
        await serve(args.head)
        return
    if args.stage in ("idle-confirm", "inspect"):
        final_stage(args.head, marker, args.stage)
        return
    info = decode(bounded(PRIVATE, 4096, private=True), 4096)
    assert set(info) == {"source_head", "run_id", "login_url", "port"}
    assert (info["source_head"], info["run_id"]) == (args.head, marker["run_id"])
    login = urlsplit(info["login_url"])
    assert login.scheme == "http"
    assert login.hostname == "127.0.0.1"
    assert login.path == "/login"
    assert type(info["port"]) is int
    assert 1024 < info["port"] < 65536
    assert login.port == info["port"]
    assert not login.fragment
    assert re.fullmatch(r"token=[0-9a-f]{64}", login.query)
    base = f"http://127.0.0.1:{login.port}"

        ) as worker,
        aiohttp.ClientSession(
            cookie_jar=aiohttp.CookieJar(unsafe=True), timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=12)
        ) as gui,

        try:

                assert response.status == 303

        except (aiohttp.ClientError, TimeoutError):
            raise RuntimeError("private workspace login unavailable") from None

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import datetime
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys
import time

import aiohttp
from sandbox_science.contracts.environments import EnvironmentInfo
from sandbox_science.contracts.provisioning import ProvisionOperation
from sandbox_science.contracts.provision_observations import RevisionSummaryPage
from sandbox_science.contracts.worker import Execution

R = Path('/home/andy/.codex/worktrees/project-macros/sandbox-crypto')
HEAD = 'ROOT_FINAL_SIGNED_HEAD_PENDING'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('lab32_reviewed_helper', R / '.agents/labs/provisioning_revision_packages.py')
assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
h = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(h)

def now():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

def path(label, phase):
    assert label in ('environment', 'gp', 'baseline') and phase in ('started', 'receipt', 'terminal', 'permission')
    return 'evidence/revision-packages-root-' + label + '-' + phase + '.json'

def exists(relative):
    return os.path.lexists(h.LAB / relative)

def load(relative):
    value = h.decode(h.bounded(relative, 65536), 65536)
    assert value['source_head'] == HEAD and value['run_id'] == marker['run_id']
    return value

def save(relative, payload):
    value = {'source_head': HEAD, 'run_id': marker['run_id'], 'observed_at': now(), **payload}
    h.write_new(relative, value, 65536)
    return value

async def call(http, method, route, body=None, timeout=12):
    h.guard(HEAD)
    assert method in ('GET', 'POST') and route.startswith('/v1/') and '#' not in route
    async with asyncio.timeout(timeout):
        async with http.request(method, h.WORKER + route, json=body,
                                allow_redirects=False, auto_decompress=False,
                                timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=timeout)) as response:
            assert response.content_type == 'application/json' and not response.headers.get('Content-Encoding')
            raw = bytearray()
            count = 0
            async for chunk in response.content.iter_chunked(8192):
                count += 1
                assert count <= 256 and len(raw) + len(chunk) <= 512 * 1024
                raw.extend(chunk)
            value = h.decode(bytes(raw), 512 * 1024)
            if response.status >= 400:
                raise RuntimeError('HTTP_' + str(response.status) + '_' + str(h.error_projection(value)['error_kind']))
            assert response.status in (200, 201)
            return value

def environment(value):
    try:
        obj = EnvironmentInfo.model_validate_json(json.dumps(value), strict=True)
    except ValueError:
        raise RuntimeError('invalid_environment_metadata') from None
    assert (obj.project_id, obj.environment_id, obj.profile, obj.policy) == ('lab32', marker['environment'], 'minimal', marker['policy'])
    assert obj.sandbox_id and re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}', obj.sandbox)
    return {key: obj.model_dump(mode='json')[key] for key in ('project_id', 'environment_id', 'profile', 'policy', 'image', 'sandbox', 'sandbox_id', 'state', 'created_at', 'updated_at')}

def operation(value, label, expected=None):
    try:
        obj = ProvisionOperation.model_validate_json(json.dumps(value), strict=True)
    except ValueError:
        raise RuntimeError('invalid_provision_metadata') from None
    assert label == 'gp'
    assert obj.request.operation_id == 'lab32-' + label + '-' + marker['run_id']
    assert (obj.request.context.project_id, obj.request.context.session_id, obj.request.context.environment_id) == ('lab32', 'main', marker['environment'])
    assert obj.request.capability == 'gp'
    assert obj.request.purpose == h.PURPOSE + ': ' + label
    assert not obj.request.conda and not obj.request.pip and not obj.request.system
    assert expected is None or obj.provision_id == expected
    return obj

def projection(obj):
    value = obj.model_dump(mode='json')
    return {key: value[key] for key in ('provision_id', 'state', 'outcome', 'reason', 'stage', 'planned_revision', 'revision_before', 'revision_after', 'policy', 'permission_request', 'queue_position', 'submitted_at', 'started_at', 'ended_at', 'seq')} | {'files_total': len(obj.files), 'changes_total': len(obj.changes), 'executions_total': len(obj.executions), 'probes_total': len(obj.probes)}

async def create(http):
    if exists(path('environment', 'receipt')):
        old = load(path('environment', 'receipt'))
        current = environment(await call(http, 'GET', '/v1/environments/' + marker['environment'] + '?project_id=lab32'))
        assert current['sandbox'] == old['binding']['sandbox'] and current['sandbox_id'] == old['binding']['sandbox_id']
        print(json.dumps({'stage': 'environment_reconciled', 'binding': current}))
        return
    if exists(path('environment', 'started')):
        load(path('environment', 'started'))
        # Reconcile the exact canonical environment; never repeat an uncertain POST.
        binding = environment(await call(http, 'GET', '/v1/environments/' + marker['environment'] + '?project_id=lab32'))
        save(path('environment', 'receipt'), {'binding': binding, 'reconciled_exact_canonical_get': True})
        print(json.dumps({'stage': 'environment_reconciled', 'binding': binding}))
        return
    save(path('environment', 'started'), {'project_id': 'lab32', 'environment_id': marker['environment'], 'method': 'POST', 'timeout_seconds': 180})
    value = await call(http, 'POST', '/v1/environments', {'project_id': 'lab32', 'environment_id': marker['environment'], 'profile': 'minimal', 'policy': marker['policy']}, 180)
    binding = environment(value)
    save(path('environment', 'receipt'), {'binding': binding, 'configured_image_tag_is_not_measured_digest': True})
    print(json.dumps({'stage': 'environment_created', 'binding': binding}))

async def provision(http, label):
    original = load(path('environment', 'receipt'))['binding']
    assert label == 'gp'
    proof = load('evidence/revision-packages-root-baseline-history.json')
    assert proof['revision'] == 0 and proof['lockfile'] is not None and proof['actual_blob_proof'] is not None
    if exists(path(label, 'receipt')):
        receipt = load(path(label, 'receipt'))
        provision_id = receipt['operation']['provision_id']
    else:
        assert not exists(path(label, 'started')), 'uncertain POST; reconcile exact operation_key before any retry'
        request = {'operation_id': 'lab32-' + label + '-' + marker['run_id'], 'context': {'project_id': 'lab32', 'session_id': 'main', 'environment_id': marker['environment']}, 'purpose': h.PURPOSE + ': ' + label, 'capability': 'gp'}
        current = environment(await call(http, 'GET', '/v1/environments/' + marker['environment'] + '?project_id=lab32'))
        assert (current['sandbox'], current['sandbox_id']) == (original['sandbox'], original['sandbox_id']), 'original VM binding changed; no POST'
        save(path(label, 'started'), {'request': request, 'method': 'POST', 'timeout_seconds': 12, 'original_binding_rechecked': {'sandbox': current['sandbox'], 'sandbox_id': current['sandbox_id']}})
        obj = operation(await call(http, 'POST', '/v1/provisioning', request), label)
        provision_id = obj.provision_id
        save(path(label, 'receipt'), {'operation': projection(obj)})
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 360
    previous = None
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        obj = operation(await call(http, 'GET', '/v1/provisioning/' + provision_id + '?project_id=lab32'), label, provision_id)
        state = (str(obj.state), str(obj.outcome), obj.seq)
        if state != previous:
            print(json.dumps({'stage': label, 'operation': projection(obj)}), flush=True)
            previous = state
        if obj.state == 'awaiting_permission':
            if not exists(path(label, 'permission')):
                save(path(label, 'permission'), {'operation': projection(obj), 'operator_review_required': True})
            return
        if obj.state == 'finished':
            assert obj.outcome == 'completed', 'operation did not complete; no automatic retry'
            if exists(path(label, 'terminal')):
                assert load(path(label, 'terminal'))['operation']['provision_id'] == provision_id
            else:
                save(path(label, 'terminal'), {'operation': projection(obj)})
            return
        await asyncio.sleep(3)
    raise RuntimeError('bounded_poll_timeout_no_resubmission')

async def baseline(http):
    original = load(path('environment', 'receipt'))['binding']
    current = environment(await call(http, 'GET', '/v1/environments/' + marker['environment'] + '?project_id=lab32'))
    assert (current['sandbox'], current['sandbox_id']) == (original['sandbox'], original['sandbox_id'])
    if exists(path('baseline', 'receipt')):
        execution_id = load(path('baseline', 'receipt'))['execution']['execution_id']
    else:
        assert not exists(path('baseline', 'started')), 'uncertain cell POST; reconcile exact operation ID before retry'
        request = {'kind': 'cell', 'context': {'project_id': 'lab32', 'session_id': 'main', 'environment_id': marker['environment']}, 'language': 'python', 'operation_id': 'lab32-baseline-' + marker['run_id'], 'timeout_seconds': 120, 'code': 'print("lab32 baseline")'}
        save(path('baseline', 'started'), {'request': request, 'original_binding_rechecked': {'sandbox': current['sandbox'], 'sandbox_id': current['sandbox_id']}})

        execution_id = obj.execution_id
        save(path('baseline', 'receipt'), {'execution': {'execution_id': execution_id, 'operation_id': obj.operation_id}})
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 180
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        obj = Execution.model_validate_json(json.dumps(await call(http, 'GET', '/v1/executions/' + execution_id)), strict=True)

        assert obj.kind == 'cell'
        if obj.state in ('succeeded','failed','cancelled','lost'):
            assert obj.state == 'succeeded'
            assert obj.location is not None and obj.location.backend == 'openshell' and obj.location.isolation_tier == 3

    route = '/v1/environments/' + marker['environment'] + '/provisioning/observations/revisions?project_id=lab32&after=-1&target=0&limit=8'

    row = next(r for r in page.revisions if r.revision == 0)
    assert row.lockfile is not None

    blob = h.blob_proofs([selected,selected])[0]; assert blob is not None
    save('evidence/revision-packages-root-baseline-history.json', {**selected,'actual_blob_proof':blob,'typed_worker_history_and_exact_selected_sql':True})
    print(json.dumps({'stage':'baseline_completed','revision':0,'lockfile':selected['lockfile'],'actual_blob_proof':blob}),flush=True)

async def main():

# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
"""Fixed Lab32 post-teardown audit. DO NOT RUN before root confirms completion."""
from __future__ import annotations
import argparse
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import stat
import subprocess

ROOT = Path('/home/andy/.codex/worktrees/project-macros/sandbox-crypto')
HEAD = '6d4c44816be8eae739cd6677326074b326ceceab'
RUN = 'bdaad7ddbad54310a37628f690ab990d'
HELPER = 'c85126d476ae03b689323102f2e9d1ea45104b0b1f60454391e90b7bfd34a94c'
CANDIDATE = '5c830a3a2ccf725ff26c698c0a13a1fb59ad1e1d4d9e56358e37109c9ea31e82'
ENVIRONMENT = 'lab32-default-11701ce03042'
VM = {'name': 'ss-580b04c0d5805b0e', 'id': 'f17f560a-1f76-4101-9b1f-8ac7ef5d6edf'}
LAB = Path.home() / '.local/state/openshell-lab'
PUBLIC = Path('/tmp/lab32-public-evidence')
UNITS = tuple('openshell-lab-' + s for s in ('workspace','mcp-forward','worker','gateway','middleware','cache','echo'))
PORTS = (8080,8090,8100,8101,34845,37005,50051,17670)
OUTPUT = Path('/tmp/lab32-post-teardown-independent-review.json')
TEXT = Path('/tmp/lab32-post-teardown-independent-review.txt')


def utc() -> str:
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()


def unique(pairs: list[tuple[str, object]]) -> dict[str, object]:
    result = {}
    for key,value in pairs:
        assert key not in result
        result[key] = value
    return result


def public_bytes(path: Path, cap: int) -> bytes:
    """Only fixed public metadata/exports supplied by this script's callers."""
    assert not path.name.endswith('.raw.log')
    assert path.name not in {'revision-packages-private.json','client-a.token','client-b.token','worker.toml'}
    fd = os.open(path,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_NONBLOCK|os.O_CLOEXEC)
    try:
        before = os.fstat(fd)
        assert stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode) and before.st_uid == os.getuid() and before.st_nlink == 1
        assert 0 <= before.st_size <= cap
        raw = os.pread(fd,cap+1,0)
        after = os.fstat(fd)
        assert len(raw) == before.st_size and len(raw) <= cap
        assert (before.st_dev,before.st_ino,before.st_size,before.st_mtime_ns) == (after.st_dev,after.st_ino,after.st_size,after.st_mtime_ns)
        return raw
    finally:
        os.close(fd)


def public_json(path: Path, cap: int = 65536) -> dict:
    value = json.loads(public_bytes(path,cap).decode('utf-8'),object_pairs_hook=unique)
    assert type(value) is dict
    return value


def scope(value: dict) -> None:
    assert (value['source_head'],value['run_id']) == (HEAD,RUN)


def command(args: list[str], cap: int = 16384) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
    """Read-only git/systemctl metadata only; no lifecycle or network commands."""
    assert args[0] in {'git','systemctl'}
    if args[0] == 'git':
        assert args[1:] in (['rev-parse','HEAD'],['log','-1','--format=%G?'],['status','--porcelain'])
    else:
        assert args[:3] == ['systemctl','--user','is-active'] and len(args) == 4 and args[3] in UNITS
    result = subprocess.run(args,cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,timeout=5)
    assert len(result.stdout) + len(result.stderr) <= cap
    return result


def pid_identity(pid: int, start: str | None) -> dict:
    assert type(pid) is int and 0 < pid < 2**31
    if start is not None:
        assert type(start) is str and re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]{1,32}',start)
    path = Path('/proc') / str(pid) / 'stat'
    try:
        raw = path.read_bytes()
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return {'pid':pid,'recorded_start_identity':start,'pid_absent':True,'original_identity_absent':True,'proof':'PID-only absence' if start is None else 'recorded PID/start identity absent'}
    assert len(raw) <= 4096
    end = raw.rfind(b')')
    assert end >= 0
    fields = raw[end+2:].split()
    assert len(fields) > 19
    current = fields[19].decode('ascii')
    assert re.fullmatch(r'[0-9]{1,32}',current)
    if start is None:
        raise AssertionError('bootstrap PID still exists; no original start identity to distinguish reuse')
    assert current != start, 'original owned process identity still exists'
    return {'pid':pid,'recorded_start_identity':start,'pid_absent':False,'original_identity_absent':True,'pid_reused_by_other_identity':True}


def known_listeners() -> dict:
    found = []
    time_wait = []
    for name in ('tcp','tcp6'):
        path = Path('/proc/net') / name
        raw = path.read_bytes()
        assert len(raw) <= 1024*1024
        lines = raw.splitlines()
        assert len(lines) <= 8192
        for line in lines[1:]:
            fields = line.split()
            assert len(fields) >= 4
            port = int(fields[1].rsplit(b':',1)[1],16)
            if port not in PORTS:
                continue
            if fields[3] == b'0A':
                found.append({'family':name,'port':port})
            elif fields[3] == b'06':
                time_wait.append({'family':name,'port':port})
    assert not found, 'known lab port still has a listener'
    return {'ports_checked':list(PORTS),'listeners':found,'time_wait_metadata':time_wait,'bind_or_connect_attempted':False,'time_wait_cause_inferred':False}


def main() -> None:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--after-root-teardown',action='store_true',required=True)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    assert args.after_root_teardown
    # Refuse before completion, before querying any process/unit/listener state.
    completed = public_json(Path('/tmp/lab32-owned-cleanup.json'))
    scope(completed)
    assert completed['lab_root_absent'] is True
    assert completed['unit_states'] == {unit:'inactive' for unit in UNITS}
    for key in ('provider_registration_raw_removed_metadata_only','workspace_private_inode_removed','original_vm_removed_by_owned_all_workspace_teardown','no_install_or_vm_repeat'):
        assert completed[key] is True
    assert completed['provider_raw_read_or_hashed'] is False
    assert completed['external_provider_or_model_request'] is False
    assert command(['git','rev-parse','HEAD']).stdout.decode().strip() == HEAD
    assert command(['git','log','-1','--format=%G?']).stdout.decode().strip() == 'G'
    assert not command(['git','status','--porcelain']).stdout
    assert hashlib.sha256(public_bytes(ROOT/'.agents/labs/provisioning_revision_packages.py',256*1024)).hexdigest() == HELPER
    owned = public_json(Path('/tmp/lab32-owned-runtime-identities.json'));scope(owned)
    restart = public_json(Path('/tmp/lab32-worker-idle-restart.json'));scope(restart)
    assert restart['unit'] == 'openshell-lab-worker'
    assert owned['serve']['port'] == 37005
    bootstrap = public_json(Path('/tmp/lab32-browser-bootstrap-result.json'));scope(bootstrap)
    assert bootstrap['pid'] == 1520673 and bootstrap['port'] == 34845 and bootstrap['consumed'] is True and type(bootstrap['closed_at']) is str
    pre = public_json(Path('/tmp/lab32-precleanup-owned-admission.json'));scope(pre)
    assert pre['single_all_workspace_owned_vm'] == {**VM,'phase':'Stopped'}
    startup = public_json(Path('/tmp/lab32-prestartup-admission.json'))
    assert startup['source_head'] == HEAD and startup['preexisting_driver_paths'] == []
    assert pre['private_literals_absent_from_public_candidates'] is True and pre['private_values_exported_or_hashed'] is False
    paths = [LAB,LAB/'revision-packages-private.json',Path('/tmp/lab32-provider-registration.raw.log')]
    absent = {str(path):not os.path.lexists(path) for path in paths}
    assert all(absent.values())

from __future__ import annotations

import asyncio
import datetime
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sys
import time

import aiohttp
from sandbox_science.contracts.environments import EnvironmentInfo
from sandbox_science.contracts.provisioning import ProvisionOperation
from sandbox_science.contracts.provision_observations import RevisionSummaryPage
from sandbox_science.contracts.worker import Execution

R = Path('/home/andy/.codex/worktrees/project-macros/sandbox-crypto')
HEAD = '0c036b78b7860e6c0aaf62cd2f9a25c3363ddef1'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('lab32_reviewed_helper', R / '.agents/labs/provisioning_revision_packages.py')
assert spec is not None and spec.loader is not None
h = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(h)

def now():
    return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()

def path(label, phase):
    assert label in ('environment', 'gp', 'baseline') and phase in ('started', 'receipt', 'terminal', 'permission')
    return 'evidence/lab32-root-' + label + '-' + phase + '.json'

def exists(relative):
    return os.path.lexists(h.LAB / relative)

def load(relative):
    value = h.decode(h.bounded(relative, 65536), 65536)
    assert value['source_head'] == HEAD and value['run_id'] == marker['run_id']
    return value

def save(relative, payload):
    value = {'source_head': HEAD, 'run_id': marker['run_id'], 'observed_at': now(), **payload}
    h.write_new(relative, value, 65536)
    return value

async def call(http, method, route, body=None, timeout=12):
    h.guard(HEAD)
    assert method in ('GET', 'POST') and route.startswith('/v1/') and '#' not in route
    async with asyncio.timeout(timeout):
        async with http.request(method, h.WORKER + route, json=body,
                                allow_redirects=False, auto_decompress=False,
                                timeout=aiohttp.ClientTimeout(total=timeout)) as response:
            assert response.content_type == 'application/json' and not response.headers.get('Content-Encoding')
            raw = bytearray()
            count = 0
            async for chunk in response.content.iter_chunked(8192):
                count += 1
                assert count <= 256 and len(raw) + len(chunk) <= 512 * 1024
                raw.extend(chunk)
            value = h.decode(bytes(raw), 512 * 1024)
            if response.status >= 400:
                raise RuntimeError('HTTP_' + str(response.status) + '_' + str(h.error_projection(value)['error_kind']))
            assert response.status in (200, 201)
            return value

def environment(value):
    try:
        obj = EnvironmentInfo.model_validate_json(json.dumps(value), strict=True)
    except ValueError:
        raise RuntimeError('invalid_environment_metadata') from None
    assert (obj.project_id, obj.environment_id, obj.profile, obj.policy) == ('lab32', marker['environment'], 'minimal', marker['policy'])
    assert obj.sandbox_id and re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}', obj.sandbox)
    return {key: obj.model_dump(mode='json')[key] for key in ('project_id', 'environment_id', 'profile', 'policy', 'image', 'sandbox', 'sandbox_id', 'state', 'created_at', 'updated_at')}

def operation(value, label, expected=None):
    try:
        obj = ProvisionOperation.model_validate_json(json.dumps(value), strict=True)
    except ValueError:
        raise RuntimeError('invalid_provision_metadata') from None
    assert label == 'gp'
    assert obj.request.operation_id == 'lab32-' + label + '-' + marker['run_id']
    assert (obj.request.context.project_id, obj.request.context.session_id, obj.request.context.environment_id) == ('lab32', 'main', marker['environment'])
    assert obj.request.capability == 'gp'
    assert obj.request.purpose == h.PURPOSE + ': ' + label
    assert not obj.request.conda and not obj.request.pip and not obj.request.system
    assert expected is None or obj.provision_id == expected
    return obj

def projection(obj):
    value = obj.model_dump(mode='json')
    return {key: value[key] for key in ('provision_id', 'state', 'outcome', 'reason', 'stage', 'planned_revision', 'revision_before', 'revision_after', 'policy', 'permission_request', 'queue_position', 'submitted_at', 'started_at', 'ended_at', 'seq')} | {'files_total': len(obj.files), 'changes_total': len(obj.changes), 'executions_total': len(obj.executions), 'probes_total': len(obj.probes)}

async def create(http):
    if exists(path('environment', 'receipt')):
        old = load(path('environment', 'receipt'))
        current = environment(await call(http, 'GET', '/v1/environments/' + marker['environment'] + '?project_id=lab32'))
        assert current['sandbox'] == old['binding']['sandbox'] and current['sandbox_id'] == old['binding']['sandbox_id']
        print(json.dumps({'stage': 'environment_reconciled', 'binding': current}))
        return
    if exists(path('environment', 'started')):
        load(path('environment', 'started'))
        # Reconcile the exact canonical environment; never repeat an uncertain POST.
        binding = environment(await call(http, 'GET', '/v1/environments/' + marker['environment'] + '?project_id=lab32'))
        save(path('environment', 'receipt'), {'binding': binding, 'reconciled_exact_canonical_get': True})
        print(json.dumps({'stage': 'environment_reconciled', 'binding': binding}))
        return
    save(path('environment', 'started'), {'project_id': 'lab32', 'environment_id': marker['environment'], 'method': 'POST', 'timeout_seconds': 180})
    value = await call(http, 'POST', '/v1/environments', {'project_id': 'lab32', 'environment_id': marker['environment'], 'profile': 'minimal', 'policy': marker['policy']}, 180)
    binding = environment(value)
    save(path('environment', 'receipt'), {'binding': binding, 'configured_image_tag_is_not_measured_digest': True})
    print(json.dumps({'stage': 'environment_created', 'binding': binding}))

async def provision(http, label):
    original = load(path('environment', 'receipt'))['binding']
    assert label == 'gp'
    proof = load('evidence/lab32-root-baseline-history.json')
    assert proof['revision'] == 0 and proof['lockfile'] is not None and proof['actual_blob_proof'] is not None
    if exists(path(label, 'receipt')):
        receipt = load(path(label, 'receipt'))
        provision_id = receipt['operation']['provision_id']
    else:
        assert not exists(path(label, 'started')), 'uncertain POST; reconcile exact operation_key before any retry'
        request = {'operation_id': 'lab32-' + label + '-' + marker['run_id'], 'context': {'project_id': 'lab32', 'session_id': 'main', 'environment_id': marker['environment']}, 'purpose': h.PURPOSE + ': ' + label, 'capability': 'gp'}
        current = environment(await call(http, 'GET', '/v1/environments/' + marker['environment'] + '?project_id=lab32'))
        assert (current['sandbox'], current['sandbox_id']) == (original['sandbox'], original['sandbox_id']), 'original VM binding changed; no POST'
        save(path(label, 'started'), {'request': request, 'method': 'POST', 'timeout_seconds': 12, 'original_binding_rechecked': {'sandbox': current['sandbox'], 'sandbox_id': current['sandbox_id']}})
        obj = operation(await call(http, 'POST', '/v1/provisioning', request), label)
        provision_id = obj.provision_id
        save(path(label, 'receipt'), {'operation': projection(obj)})
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 360
    previous = None
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        obj = operation(await call(http, 'GET', '/v1/provisioning/' + provision_id + '?project_id=lab32'), label, provision_id)
        state = (str(obj.state), str(obj.outcome), obj.seq)
        if state != previous:
            print(json.dumps({'stage': label, 'operation': projection(obj)}), flush=True)
            previous = state
        if obj.state == 'awaiting_permission':
            if not exists(path(label, 'permission')):
                save(path(label, 'permission'), {'operation': projection(obj), 'operator_review_required': True})
            return
        if obj.state == 'finished':
            assert obj.outcome == 'completed', 'operation did not complete; no automatic retry'
            if exists(path(label, 'terminal')):
                assert load(path(label, 'terminal'))['operation']['provision_id'] == provision_id
            else:
                save(path(label, 'terminal'), {'operation': projection(obj)})
            return
        await asyncio.sleep(3)
    raise RuntimeError('bounded_poll_timeout_no_resubmission')

def baseline_execution(raw, expected=None):
    obj = Execution.model_validate_json(json.dumps(raw), strict=True)
    assert expected is None or obj.execution_id == expected
    assert obj.operation_id == 'lab32-baseline-' + marker['run_id']
    assert (obj.context.project_id,obj.context.session_id,obj.context.environment_id) == ('lab32','main',marker['environment'])
    assert obj.kind == 'cell'

def utc() -> str:

def identity(info: os.stat_result) -> tuple[int, int]:
    return info.st_dev, info.st_ino


def directory(relative: str = "") -> int:
    held = os.open(LAB, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        assert os.fstat(held).st_uid == os.getuid()
        for name in relative.split("/") if relative else ():
            assert name not in {"", ".", ".."}
            assert re.fullmatch("[a-zA-Z0-9._-]+", name)
            child = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW, dir_fd=held)
            os.close(held)
            held = child
            assert os.fstat(held).st_uid == os.getuid()
        return held

        os.close(held)

def read_fd(fd: int, limit: int) -> bytes:
    before = os.fstat(fd)
    assert stat.S_ISREG(before.st_mode)
    assert before.st_uid == os.getuid()
    assert before.st_nlink == 1
    assert 0 <= before.st_size <= limit
    raw = os.pread(fd, limit + 1, 0)
    after = os.fstat(fd)
    assert len(raw) == before.st_size
    assert len(raw) <= limit
    assert (before.st_dev, before.st_ino, before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns) == (
        after.st_dev,
        after.st_ino,
        after.st_size,
        after.st_mtime_ns,
    )
    return raw


def bounded(relative: str, limit: int = 128 * 1024, *, private: bool = False) -> bytes:

    try:
        fd = os.open(name, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK, dir_fd=root)
        try:
            if private:

        finally:

    finally:

def error_projection(value: Any) -> dict[str, str | None]:

    allowed = {

        "unsupported",
        "unavailable",

        "not_found",
        "conflict",

        "cancelled",

        count = total = scanned = 0
        with os.scandir(root) as entries:
            for entry in entries:
                scanned += 1
                assert scanned <= 1024
                if entry.name.startswith("revision-packages-"):
                    info = entry.stat(follow_symlinks=False)
                    assert stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode)
                    assert info.st_uid == os.getuid()
                    assert info.st_nlink == 1
                    assert 0 <= info.st_size <= 2 * 1024 * 1024
                    count += 1
                    total += info.st_size
        assert count < 16
        assert total + len(raw) <= 8 * 1024 * 1024
    finally:
        os.close(root)
    write_new("evidence/revision-packages-" + name + ".json", value, 2 * 1024 * 1024)

async def serve(head: str) -> None:
    marker = guard(head)
    build = assets()
    token = uuid.uuid4().hex + uuid.uuid4().hex
    worker = WorkerClient(WORKER, worker_token())
    runner: web.AppRunner | None = None
    stop = asyncio.Event()
    loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
    for sig in (signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGINT):
        loop.add_signal_handler(sig, stop.set)
    owned: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
    port = None
    errors: list[str] = []
    try:
        app = create_app(
            ProjectStore(CONTROL),
            SOURCE / "web/workspace/dist",
            login_token=token,
            job_worker=worker,
        )
        runner = web.AppRunner(app, access_log=None)
        await runner.setup()
        site = web.TCPSite(runner, "127.0.0.1", 0)
        await site.start()
        assert len(runner.addresses) == 1
        port = runner.addresses[0][1]
        assert type(port) is int
        assert 1024 < port < 65536
        write_new(
            PRIVATE,
            {
                "source_head": head,
                "run_id": marker["run_id"],
                "login_url": f"http://127.0.0.1:{port}/login?token={token}",
                "port": port,
            },
            4096,
            ownership=owned,
        )
        save(
            marker,
            "server",
            {
                "port": port,
                "pid": os.getpid(),
                "assets": build,
                "inputs": marker["inputs"],
                "helper_sha256": marker["helper_sha256"],
            },
        )
        print(
            json.dumps(
                {
                    "stage": "serve",
                    "port": port,
                    "pid": os.getpid(),
                    "source_head": head,
                    "run_id": marker["run_id"],
                }
            ),
            flush=True,
        )
        await stop.wait()
    finally:
        closers = [worker.close]
        if runner is not None:
            closers.insert(0, runner.cleanup)
        for close in closers:
            try:
                await close()
            except BaseException as error:
                errors.append(type(error).__name__)
        removed = False
        if owned:
            try:
                removed = remove_private(owned[0])
            except BaseException as error:
                errors.append(type(error).__name__)
        save(
            marker,
            "workspace-cleanup",
            {
                "utc": utc(),
                "port": port,
                "runner_cleanup_attempted": runner is not None,
                "private_removed": removed,
                "private_created_by_this_process": bool(owned),
                "errors": errors,
            },
        )
        for sig in (signal.SIGTERM, signal.SIGINT):
            loop.remove_signal_handler(sig)
        assert not errors, "workspace cleanup did not complete"
